summary: First test iteration of the rebuilt Magic Game Store. Backend: 39/40 pytest cases pass (products list/filter/sort/search, product detail with related, auth register/login/me/patch/logout, orders CRUD with validation, guest+authed orders, tracking, MVola simulation initiate/status/auto-complete after ~8-10s, admin simulate failed, MVola/Orange callback error paths, admin orders/stats/CSV/status toggle/products CRUD/events CRUD/like toggle, RBAC 403 for customer on /admin/*). One real security bug: brute-force lockout does not trigger. Frontend: Home, Catalog (all tabs+filters+search+sort), Product page, cart drawer with qty +/- and total, Checkout MVola simulation → payment-status → payment-success (~11s) → order-number MGS-XXXXXX → tracking page with status Payée; Auth register→/compte→profile-save→logout; wrong password shows auth-error; /compte unauth → /connexion; /admin as customer → /; admin login shows nav-admin; admin dashboard with tabs orders/products/events, online-toggle works, product dialog opens, events like toggles count 0→1; track-error on wrong pubg id; mobile bottom-nav visible <768px. Language toggle FR↔EN works. Admin online status left = true at end.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout NEVER triggers behind Kubernetes ingress. Identifier is built as `{request.client.host}:{email}` in routers/auth.py:82. In this deployment the client IP rotates between multiple pod/proxy IPs (observed 10.79.165.8 and 10.79.165.9 splitting the count 3+3 after 6 attempts) so the counter never reaches MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 on any single row. Verified: 8 consecutive wrong logins all returned 401, no 429. Fix: honor X-Forwarded-For (first hop) OR key on email alone (or email + hashed IP with proper proxy trust). Security impact: HIGH — credential stuffing possible.

minor.issue: Returns 400 while review spec implies 422 for validation. Currently pydantic-level validation only fires on pubg_id/phone-format; the payment_method/phone cross-field check is an explicit 400. Non-blocking, but consider unifying to 422 for cross-field checks.
Simulated completion took ~10s (spec: ~8s). Acceptable within tolerance; frontend polls every 3s so users see success within one extra poll cycle.

ui_bugs.issue: `data-testid=simulation-notice` not detected in DOM when the payment card is in the waiting state (checked immediately after pay-button and again during polling). The yellow 'Mode simulation…' text is visible on the checkout form BEFORE submit, but the notice inside the payment-status card appears to be missing or unlabeled. Non-blocking — the flow still succeeds — but the selector requested in the review is not queryable.

issues: Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — a11y improvement, add DialogDescription or aria-describedby.

action_items: SECURITY (HIGH): Fix brute-force lockout identifier in /app/backend/routers/auth.py — do NOT rely on request.client.host alone behind K8s ingress. Recommended: `identifier = email.lower()` (rate-limit per account) plus, optionally, a global IP rate-limit using `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip()` when the proxy is trusted.

MINOR: Add `data-testid='simulation-notice'` element inside the PaymentStatus waiting card in /app/frontend/src/pages/Checkout.js (or its child component) so it is queryable during simulation waiting state.
MINOR (a11y): Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to shadcn Dialog usages (cart drawer, admin product dialog, admin event dialog).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py brute-force keying is broken behind reverse-proxy — see action item above.
orders.py mixes explicit 400 for missing cross-field payment_phone/manual_reference with 422 from pydantic — consistent 422 with a model-level validator would be cleaner.
server.py + routers correctly exclude Mongo `_id` via projection PUBLIC={_id:0}. Good.
seed_admin behavior not directly verified in this run, but admin login is idempotent and works.
payments router properly restricts /simulate to admin and uses require_admin dependency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (1 minor selector missing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend & frontend are largely healthy. Focus on: (1) verifying brute-force lockout after main agent's fix — reuse tests/backend_test.py::TestAuth::test_5_wrong_attempts_lock; (2) verifying simulation-notice testid presence in Checkout PaymentStatus. Admin online status was restored to true at end. PAYMENT_MODE=simulation was not modified. Note: auto-complete latency observed ~10s (spec ~8s), keep 12-15s wait margins in UI polling tests.
rca_of_the_issue: Brute-force lockout: routers/auth.py builds `identifier = f"{request.client.host if request.client else 'na'}:{email}"` and stores counts in `db.login_attempts`. Behind Kubernetes ingress, FastAPI sees the proxy/pod IP as `request.client.host`, which varies across load-balanced connections. Observed two distinct rows (10.79.165.8:.. count=3, 10.79.165.9:.. count=3) after 6 wrong attempts against the same email — neither row reached the 5-attempt threshold, so `_check_lock` never raises 429. Reproduction: `for i in range(8): POST /api/auth/login {email:same, password:'wrong'}` → all 401. Mitigation: switch identifier to email-based (per-account) rate limiting, or trust X-Forwarded-For when behind known proxy.
